# deVee Music

> deVee Music is the official site of David "deVee" Ben David, a music producer and sound engineer based in Even Yehuda, Israel, and home of deVee Boutique Label. It offers recording, production, mixing and mastering services, plus free tools and exclusive plugins for artists.

deVee Music combines analog warmth and digital precision in a personalized boutique studio experience. Tagline: "Let's Do Music."

## Services

- [Music Production](https://www.devee-music.com/): Full-scale music production from scratch for artists and brands.
- [Recording](https://www.devee-music.com/): Premium vocal and instrument recording in an acoustically treated studio.
- [Mixing & Mastering](https://www.devee-music.com/): Precise, modern mixing and mastering tailored to streaming standards.
- [Artist Development](https://www.devee-music.com/): Consulting, global digital distribution, and artistic guidance.

## Tools & Plugins

- [Tools for Artists](https://www.devee-music.com/#utilities): Free web tools for music creators.
- [Plugins for Artists](https://www.devee-music.com/): Audio plugins, including the deVee Exclusive plugin 360 (sign-in required to download).
